name: @zcaceres/skill-laconic
description: Answer in a spare, plain voice: lead with the point, complete sentences, no filler or hedging. Persisted per project or per user, in prose-only, prose+code, or laconic-code (code-first) mode. A per-turn reminder refocuses the voice mid-session (cadence configurable). Invoke via /laconic (on|off|status|mode|cadence).
